SELECT o.id, o.request_id, o.generation_source, o.source_order_no, o.source_order_time, o.owner_company_id, dc.company_name AS owner_company_name, o.item_count, o.total_quantity, o.status, o.operator_user_id, o.operator_user_name, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM service_code_generate_order o LEFT JOIN dealer_company dc ON dc.company_id = o.owner_company_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.generation_source = 'B2B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS b2b, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.generation_source = 'OFFLINE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS offline FROM service_code_generate_order o LEFT JOIN dealer_company dc ON dc.company_id = o.owner_company_id
